original_test_intent: Validate TEMP_UBB_BACK as the owner-defined rear UBB temperature location, distinguishing board-surface from rear-air/exhaust sensing, with correct orientation and consistent identity, value and state across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: The mechanical/thermal owner provides sensor coordinates, chassis airflow direction, probe type and any GPU association and approves limits for the recorded operating condition; automation performs passive complete collection without executing annotation text.
manual_activity: The mechanical/thermal owner defines rear orientation and exact probe coordinates, identifies whether it measures board surface or exhaust air, confirms any GPU relation, and approves condition-specific limits. CX7 and front-sensor evidence remain separate.
required_inputs: UBB/chassis assembly revision, coordinate system and airflow direction
TEMP_UBB_BACK probe coordinate, mounting, type and board-surface versus air-stream meaning
Nearby GPU/VR/power components and any approved AMDGPU identity association
Exact SDR entity/name/description and Sensor List/Web mapping
Units, scale, resolution, tolerance, sampling/freshness and thermal response lag
Ranges/thresholds by workload, power, fan mode, inlet/ambient and altitude if applicable
Same-target IB/OOB identity and BMC/SDR/board/GPU revisions
Secret-safe collectors plus independent thermal/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Bind exact row 1879 and exclude the duplicate CX7 Web workflow
Do not infer that BACK means exhaust air, board underside or a particular GPU
Do not append `(AMDGPU)` to shell commands
Retain complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List before filtering and capture Web evidence
Do not start workload, reload drivers, change fans/power/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on orientation/mapping ambiguity, stale/invalid data, unsafe temperature, airflow fault or path disagreement; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact source/variant, duplicate isolation, UBB orientation and same-target identity
Record passive workload/power/fan/inlet state and any approved GPU identity
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus exact UBB_BACK and Web evidence
Compare identity, value, unit, state and freshness without assuming front/rear equivalence
Perform no annotation execution, thermal-state change, CX7 substitution or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve rear coordinate, orientation and board-versus-air sensor semantics
Define any GPU association and nearby heat-source map
Provide operating-condition ranges, thresholds and lag expectation
Review evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The exact sensor query is useful only after physical mapping; it lacks IB, complete Sensor List and Web, truncates SDR and exposes credentials. Parenthesized AMDGPU is not executable syntax.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus exact sensor and Web capture, recording orientation, airflow and passive operating context without changing fans or load.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES UBB REAR LOCATION, AIRFLOW SEMANTICS AND THERMAL-CRITERIA PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Annotate the probe on the mechanical airflow drawing and capture synchronized management readings with inlet, fan and load context; compare only to limits for that sensing medium and position.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines what rear means and whether the measurement is board or air temperature before applying a SPEC.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: CX7 chip temperatures and the adjacent UBB_FRONT sensor are distinct spatial measurements and cannot substitute for UBB_BACK.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A rear air sensor may legitimately run warmer than a front/inlet probe, while a board probe can lag airflow changes; applying the wrong spatial limit produces false failures or hides recirculation.

project_override_considerations: If chassis airflow can reverse or vary by SKU, the required orientation/mode must be recorded. If BACK is a logical aggregate, the contributing sources and aggregation rule require owner approval.
expected_evidence: Mechanical coordinate/orientation and airflow drawing with probe type
Nearby heat-source and any AMDGPU relationship
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus exact result
Reading/state/unit/freshness with fan, inlet, workload/power, ambient and applicable limit
BMC Web and passive GPU/power/SEL context
Same-target proof, exit status, hashes and annotation-handling audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1879 consistently targets TEMP_UBB_BACK; physical meaning and AMDGPU relation are missing inputs. The code collision with CX7 is isolated by source row and variant.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive rear-sensor check is identifiable once spatial and thermal semantics are supplied under ED-36.

review_improvement: Isolates the CX7 duplicate and converts BACK from a vague name into an owner-approved spatial and airflow identity, preventing front, chip or exhaust values from being conflated.
independent_technical_reasoning: Temperature is spatial: the rear of a UBB can represent an exhaust air stream or a local board hotspot, each with different response time and acceptable range. The same numeric value has different meaning under those two models, so coordinate and sensing-medium provenance are mandatory.
